newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index rises in easier trading week.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index rises in easier trading week.

text.p: Kuwait Stock Exchange's (KSE) index rose 50.4 points to 2,412 during the week to Wednesday but value and volume of traded shares eased compared to the previous week, figures released on Thursday showed.

Daily average value of traded shares fell to 14.18 million dinars ($46.5 million) from 18.96 million dinars. Trade volume declined to a daily average of 44.7 million shares from 54.1 million, KSE figures show.
Gainers led losers 45-7, while 19 shares were non-movers.
Investment firms were the most active sector in terms of traded value with 21.2 million dinars, followed by industrials with 18.8 million and property firms with 9.6 million.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
